bio: Peter Nikolaidis discovered his passion for computers and information technology at a young age. An IT and security professional, Peter practices yoga, martial arts, running, biking, as well as self-improvement and mindfulness.

Scott is an old school semiconductor guy, painfully infrequent writer, and off and on podcaster. Scott loves playing with computers, biking, running, yoga, and cats. Most of all, Scott loves his amazing family.
